verdict.rationale: Community reports show TeamViewer clients exist on Windows (comm-3, comm-6 on registry-stored credentials) and on macOS, where a user installs it to control another desktop (comm-14). That gives thin evidence of multi-desktop-OS coverage. The Mobile SDK add-on is a developer building block and the mobile device management item is an adjacent feature, so neither shows mobile clients. Missing for 10: first-party docs listing supported desktop and mobile platforms, Linux client evidence, iOS/Android viewer or host apps, and explicit confirmation that host and viewer can run on different operating systems.
